cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Exactly Within Policy
cards.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Yes, I'll clean the hall. The policy lets senior volunteers supervise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm asking you to mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Exactly. Supervising the mop is covered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who will hold it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone whose contribution isn't restricted by seniority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For a wedding cake, we weigh the flour. Please put that mug down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quicker. I've used three mugs already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Show me the mug, and I'll weigh one mugful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used three different mugs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll clean the hall. The policy lets senior volunteers supervise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm asking you to mop.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who will hold it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone whose contribution isn't restricted by seniority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course I'll host Christmas, within our family's shared-effort rule.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So what will you cook?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The rule says hosting counts as effort.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Does it mention cooking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not once hosting has been counted generously enough.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I'll add an appeals procedure before we serve anything.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And let inferior equipment take credit for my defeat?

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow you'll say the scales were generous. Stay for the number.
